summary: A figure in classical robes stands in profile holding a burnt-orange document covered with symbols and diagrams, positioned before a horizontal band of intricate circuit-like patterns on the left and ruled columnar data on the right, all framed by tessellating geometric fish and bird forms.

pairs.see: The burnt-orange document held in both hands, covered with mathematical symbols, Greek letters, and small diagrams
pairs.represents: the annotated leaderboard page with handwritten notes questioning suspicious benchmark jumps

pairs.see: The dense circuit-like labyrinth pattern filling the left panel behind the figure
pairs.represents: the complexity of AI systems being scrutinized and reported on

pairs.see: The ruled columnar grid on the right panel, resembling a data table or spreadsheet
pairs.represents: the comparison table of model names and benchmark scores

pairs.see: The tessellating fish and birds forming an interlocking border around the central scene
pairs.represents: working across disciplines, the intersection of technical and sociological perspectives

pairs.see: The figure's classical pose and timeless robes contrasting with technical elements
pairs.represents: maintaining independence and objectivity, refusing to wear the jersey of any corporate AI lab
